consequence.statement: Wildcard view permissions are replaced by a role binding to the system view role; admission behavior is unaffected, but mutate and generate policies for custom resources and reporting of validation results on custom resources may be impacted.
consequence.remediation: Follow the upgrade guidance; a Helm option exists to upgrade without breaking existing policies.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13 removed its wildcard view permissions and replaced them with a role binding to the system view role, which may affect mutate/generate policies and reporting for custom resources.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Text says only users with mutate/generate policies or validation reporting on custom resources may be impacted; the exact Helm option and a static condition are not named in the evidence.
